about: Computed-style baseline of the shell area (owner WP2) for scripts/style-snapshot.browser.test.mjs. Per page and selector: full values at space@1440, then only the properties that differ at the other theme@width combinations; omitted properties have the default value listed in the test. Regenerate with: node scripts/style-snapshot.browser.test.mjs --area shell --write (against a fresh build).
